The one material gap - validation.json lacks detailed entries for comparison_reference.json and compatibility_report.json despite their pinned baselines, and package manifest/started marker/receipt/original CSV bytes/validator implementation are absent - is disclosed by the proposal itself, correctly treated as a limitation that leaves full system acceptance undecided, and is not concealed; it blocks acceptance, which the proposal does not request, not this proposal-only review. Advisories (recorded, non-blocking): (a) reconcile the two missing JSON comparisons and package/receipt evidence through the existing system before any acceptance decision; (b) the flattened source hash differs from the binding notebook_code_sha256, so cell serialization remains attributed, not verified - the proposal states this; (c) datetime.utcnow and pandas groupby deprecation warnings in the saved outputs remain maintenance advisories; (d) prior open findings (S9-03, S9-04.x, S10-R4-01..04, S9-R4-x) are correctly kept open without claimed closure receipts. Exploratory status, 69/30 prior development-outcome exposure, annotation-assisted cached features, mask constraints, single-seed clinical arms and whole-pipeline (not architecture-isolating) comparison limitations are all preserved; reproduced known results are distinguished from new efficacy evidence throughout. No unresolved blocker is concealed by this APPROVE.
